high_level_description: This image captures a serene evening scene with a clear sky transitioning from blue to hues of pink and orange near the horizon, indicating either sunrise or sunset. The sky is mostly clear with a few scattered clouds, adding depth to the view. In the foreground, there is a prominent structure that appears to be part of a bridge or an overpass. It has a modern design with vertical supports and a curved arch at the top. The structure is illuminated by artificial lighting, which casts a warm glow on its surface, contrasting with the cool tones of the sky.
